notes.title: The beginning of the history of Honey
notes.content:
Hello everyone
Already now you can get acquainted with the beginning of the history of Honey - how he got to the war and about his first days at the front. 

Well, at the same time it will be possible to evaluate the mechanics of our virtual comic.
Available in this update:
[list]
[*] 9 scenes!
[*] more than 43 pages of comics!
[*] Accelerated animation of opening pages.
[*] Fixed bugs.
[/list]
